rows.heading: APAR Benchmark for Time-Bound Promotion
rows.quote_snippet: 3.1 Performance Benchmark Threshold: To qualify for time-bound promotion, an executive must maintain a consistent track record of satisfactory performance across the qualifying residency years: (a) For E1→E2: Minimum cumulative rating of 'Good' (score ≥ 3.0 / 60%) in the annual e-APAR ratings for the preceding 3 years.
